response.name: Malum 1.7.3
response.changelog:
Added the missing Soul Stained Steel Scythe Arcane Restoration Recipe

Added missing recipes for Repairing Weeping Well Gear using the Repair Pylon

Added the missing Warp Flux Block

The Sundering Anchor can now only hit a single target up to five times and will return early if it cannot find any other valid target afterwards

The Sundering Anchor Projectile no longer deals double the intended damage

Big Boner Necklace in the Works

Updated Spirit Entity Behavior and Visuals
When Spirits are created without the help of a player they will now enter a passive state
- While in this passive state, spirits will slowly fall towards the ground, becoming an actual item upon collision
- Passive spirits can still be collected by a player however the range is much shorter and requires line of sight with the player
- This should hopefully allow for a more innate and automation-friendly behavior

Updated Several Rune Effects

Rune of Idle Restoration -> Rune of Vitality

+Passive Healing -> +20% Healing Received

Rune of Culling

+20% Scythe Proficiency -> +Scythes Exploit Wounds

Rune of Reactive Shielding -> Rune of Protection

+Damage Resistance when Struck -> +20% Armor

Rune of Sacrificial Empowerment -> Rune of Farsweeping

+Scythe Kill Chaining -> +Deadlier Scythe Sweeping

Rune of Toughness -> Rune of Indomitability

+20% Armor Toughness -> +100% Knockback Resistance

Updated Some Geas Effects

Pact of The Liveweaver:
- Added Passive Healing Effect no longer present on the rune

Pact of Reciprocation:
- Now only applies to Magic Damage as was intended

All Magic Damage in Malum now pierces Half of the Armor Value as opposed to All of It. Magic Damage still does not damage Armor despite this change.
This can be disabled using a config option

Updated the textures for the Alchemical Calx Block
Updated the textures for the Catalyst Lobber

Removed the entire Spirit Ritual system that utilized the Ritual Plinth
- It was nowhere near the ideal state I now imagine Spirit Rituals to be, and was causing some issues so I figured that since I'll end up replacing it in the future I might as well remove it now.

Actually Fixed Create Compat not Working

Fixed Repair Pylon not correctly repairing Fractured Impetuses

Fixed Copper and Iron Impetuses incorrectly having two separate Arcane Restoration Recipes

Fixed Repair Pylon Causing Network Issues when Repairing Enchanted Items

Fixed the Spirit Crucible and Spirit Altar not properly continuing work after being loaded from chunk memory

Fixed the Ring of the Howling Maelstrom taking effect when hitting an enemy with a rebound scythe when wearing the Necklace of the Narrow Edge even without the ring

Fixed Scarstone dropping even without proper tools

Fixed Transmutation Tree Pages Displaying Translation Keys instead of Translated Headlines

Fixed Max Durability still being transfered across gear during Spirit Infusion

Fixed Enchantments not carring if the newly created item can actually support them when carrying over the enchantment during Spirit Infusion

Fix Modded Metal Node Smelting Recipes not actually working despite JEI showing so

response.name: Malum 1.7.2
response.changelog:
Added a Particle Effect for the Rite of Growth

Added the ability to put Malum Plants into Pots

Added Scarstone, Strangeroots and Strange Crystals
- These are rare new world generation features you can create by spreading blight

Added the missing Soulwoven Banner Pattern for the Wicked Spirit; Sword

Added new sounds for Brilliance and Natural Quartz Ore

Updated the charge-up particle effect for the Unwinding Chaos

Updated Blight Propagation particle effects

Updated the looks of various Blight Decals

Corrected some Codex entries

Corrected any use of the word "Aliment" in place of "Ailment"

Made the requirement for a blood sacrifice in the gease entry a bit more descriptive

Split the Totemic Runes entry across all the respective totem rite entries

Removed Runic and Cursed Sap Blocks
- These may return in the future, but at the moment I do not see a way to make them interesting

Fixed Spirit Infusion copying durability and attribute data from gear over to the result
 - This is done through a blacklist tag for component types

Fixed a crash tied to the Sundering Anchor encountered when loading into a world with the thrown anchor loaded from memory

Fixed Arcanaphage Geas crashing when taking sourceless damage

Fixed Hereic Rune crashing when taking sourecless damage

Fixed detailed spirit descriptions still being wrong

Fixed certain totem effect particles appearing excessively

Fixed Create Recipe Compat Not Working

Fixed Raw Brilliance and Raw Soulstone becoming Raw Soulstone in Weeping Well Transmutation

Fixed the Malignant Stronghold Scarf remaining even when the associated entity is killed

Fixed the Geas Effect book page having misaligned text when using the easy reading book style

Fixed other stuff too

response.name: Malum 1.7.1
response.changelog:
- Added a config option to control the maximum length of the Malignant Stronghold Scarf
- Added two new Blight Plants
- Condensed the two Blighted Blocks into one
- Updated Blight Generation and Visuals
 - Should hopefully be less intrusive and *slightly* more visually pleasing
 - This isn't the last update Blight will receive, the goal is to make it at least slightly pleasant to look at ahaha
- Updated the Repair Pylon Visuals Slightly
- The Sundering Anchor now goes on Cooldown when Thrown in addition to when Returned
 - This is to prevent the player from being able to throw 9 anchors at once
- The Sundering Anchor now more eagerly attacks targets when there is only one in range
- Updated Recipes for Soul Stained Steel Repair using the Repair Pylon

- Fixed Particle Networking Related Crashes On Clients when connected to a server
- Fixed Ether and Weapons Armor Tools etc. not carrying over data components when used in spirit infusion
- Fixed Edge of Deliverance not having proper Better Combat integration
- Fixed the Repair Pylon not accepting recipes
- Fixed Soul Ward not being visible
- Fixed Weeping Well Blocks being movable via Rite of Gravity
- Fixed Weeping Well not accepting items in some cases
- Hopefully Fixed Weeping Well not displaying particle previews for items that can be transmutated
- Fixed Spirit Rite Pages displaying the wrong name and hover info
- Fixed some Hat Layer Clipping with the Soul Hunter Cloak
- Fixed the tophat not rendering
